dialogues.korean: 일반 세탁과 빠른 세탁 중 어느 것을 원하세요?

choices.text: When will I get my clothes back with regular service?
Express, please. I need them by tomorrow morning.

dialogues.speaker: driver
dialogues.english: Hi! Are you the one who ordered the Uber?

choices.text: Yes, that's me. Are you John?
Can you confirm the destination is Central Station?
Yes! Can we make a quick stop on the way?

dialogues.speaker: taxi_driver
dialogues.english: Where to?

choices.text: How much will it cost to the airport?
Can we take the fastest route? I have a flight to catch.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Welcome! How can I help you explore Amsterdam?

choices.text: Do you have a free city map?
Is the I amsterdam City Card worth it?

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Would you like to print photos from your phone?

choices.text: Yes, how can I transfer them?

dialogues.speaker: local
dialogues.english: Excuse me, is this spot taken?

choices.text: No, go ahead. There's plenty of room.
Actually, my friends are coming. Maybe the spot over there?
Sure, join us! We have extra snacks.

dialogues.speaker: staff
dialogues.english: Would you like to rent a pedal boat? It's 15 euros per hour.

choices.text: How many people can fit in one boat?
Is there a map of the canals?

dialogues.speaker: volunteer
dialogues.english: Welcome to the festival! Can I see your ticket?
dialogues.korean: 페스티벌에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 티켓을 보여주시겠어요?

choices.text: Here's my e-ticket. Where's the main stage?
choices.feedback: 티켓을 보여주며 메인 스테이지 위치를 물었어요.

choices.text: Is there a schedule of performances?
Where can I get food and drinks?

dialogues.speaker: vendor
dialogues.english: This traditional Dutch souvenir is 25 euros.

choices.text: If I buy two, can you give me a discount?
That's a bit out of my budget. How about 18 euros?
I'll think about it. Thank you.
